title: पञ्चत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 35 · Abhimanyu breaks into the array

summary.en: Abhimanyu urges his charioteer toward Drona's array and plunges in, shattering the Kaurava ranks, while the Pandavas follow behind. The battlefield is filled with the sons and fathers he cuts down.
summary.kn: ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯು ಸಾರಥಿಗೆ ದ್ರೋಣನ ವ್ಯೂಹದತ್ತ ಹೋಗಲು ಹೇಳಿ ಒಳನುಗ್ಗಿ ಕೌರವ ಸಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಒಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಪಾಂಡವರು ಹಿಂದೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅವನು ಕಡಿದ ತಂದೆ-ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಂದ ರಣರಂಗ ತುಂಬುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: अभिमन्यु सारथी को द्रोण के व्यूह की ओर चलने को कहता है और भीतर घुसकर कौरव पंक्तियाँ तोड़ता है, पाण्डव पीछे आते हैं। उसके काटे पिताओं और पुत्रों से रणभूमि भर जाती है।
summary.te: అభిమన్యుడు సారథిని ద్రోణుని వ్యూహం వైపు నడపమని చెప్పి లోపలికి దూకి కౌరవ వరుసలను ఛేదిస్తాడు; పాండవులు వెనుక వస్తారు. అతను నరికిన తండ్రులు, కొడుకులతో రణభూమి నిండుతుంది.
summary.ta: அபிமன்யு தேரோட்டியிடம் த்ரோணரின் வியூகத்தை நோக்கிச் செலுத்தச் சொல்லி உள்ளே பாய்ந்து கௌரவ அணிகளை உடைக்கிறான்; பாண்டவர் பின்தொடர்கின்றனர். அவன் வெட்டிய தந்தையரும் மகன்களும் களத்தை நிரப்புகின்றனர்.
summary.ml: അഭിമന്യു സാരഥിയോട് ദ്രോണരുടെ വ്യൂഹത്തിലേക്ക് തേര് തെളിക്കാൻ പറയുന്നു; അദ്ദേഹം കൗരവ നിരകൾ തകർത്ത് ഉള്ളിലേക്ക് കടക്കുന്നു, പാണ്ഡവർ പിന്നാലെ വരുന്നു. അദ്ദേഹം വെട്ടിവീഴ്ത്തിയ പുത്രന്മാരും പിതാക്കന്മാരും കൊണ്ട് രണഭൂമി നിറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.35; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
सौभद्रस्तु वचः श्रुत्वा धर्मराजस्य धीमतः ।
अचोदयत यन्तारं द्रोणानीकाय भारत ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the wise king of dharma's words, Subhadra's son urged his charioteer toward Drona's division, O Bharata.

verses.text:
तेन संचोद्यमानस्तु याहि याहीति सारथिः ।
प्रत्युवाच ततो राजन्नभिमन्युमिदं वचः ॥

meaning.en: Urged on, "Go! Go!", the charioteer then answered Abhimanyu with these words, O king.

verses.text:
अतिभारोऽयमायुष्मन्नाहितस्त्वयि पाण्डवैः ।
संप्रधार्य क्षमं बुद्ध्या ततस्त्वं योद्धुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: "Long-lived one, the Pandavas have laid too great a burden on you. Having considered what is fit with your mind, you should then fight."

verses.text:
आचार्यो हि कृती द्रोणः परमास्त्रे कृतश्रमः ।
अत्यन्तसुखसंवृद्धस्त्वं च युद्धविशारदः ॥

meaning.en: "Drona the teacher is accomplished and has labored at the highest weapons, while you were raised in great comfort, though skilled in battle."

verses.text:
ततोऽभिमन्युः प्रहसन्सारथिं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
सारथे को न्वयं द्रोणः समग्रं क्षत्रमेव वा ॥

meaning.en: Then Abhimanyu, laughing, said to his charioteer: "Charioteer, who is this Drona, or the whole Kshatriya order?"

verses.text:
ऐरावतगतं शक्रं सहामरगणैरहम् ।
योधयेयं रणमुखे न मे क्षत्रेऽद्य विस्मयः ।
न ममैतद्द्विषत्सैन्यं कलामर्हति षोडशीम् ॥

meaning.en: "I could fight Shakra on Airavata with the hosts of the immortals at the head of the battle; I feel no wonder today at the Kshatriyas. This enemy army is not worth a sixteenth part of me."

verses.text:
अपि विश्वजितं विष्णुं मातुलं प्राप्य सूतज ।
पितरं चार्जुनं संख्ये न भीर्मामुपयास्यति ॥

meaning.en: "Even if I met Vishnu, conqueror of the universe, my uncle, or my father Arjuna in battle, fear would not come to me."

verses.text:
ततोऽभिमन्युस्तां वाचं कदर्थीकृत्य सारथेः ।
याहीत्येवाब्रवीदेनं द्रोणानीकाय माचिरम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Abhimanyu, making light of the charioteer's words, said "Go!" and told him not to delay toward Drona's division.

verses.text:
ततः संचोदयामास हयानस्य त्रिहायनान् ।
नातिहृष्टमनाः सूतो हेमभाण्डपरिच्छदान् ॥

meaning.en: Not very glad at heart, the charioteer urged on his three-year-old horses with golden trappings.

verses.text:
ते प्रेषिताः सुमित्रेण द्रोणानीकाय वाजिनः ।
द्रोणमभ्यद्रवन्राजन्महावेगपराक्रमाः ॥

meaning.en: Sent by Sumitra, those horses of great speed and valor ran toward Drona's division, O king.

verses.text:
तमुदीक्ष्य तथायान्तं सर्वे द्रोणपुरोगमाः ।
अभ्यवर्तन्त कौरव्याः पाण्डवाश्च तमन्वयुः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him come, all the Kauravas led by Drona advanced, and the Pandavas followed him.

verses.text:
स कर्णिकारप्रवरोच्छ्रितध्वजः
सुवर्णवर्मार्जुनिरर्जुनाद्वरः ।
युयुत्सया द्रोणमुखान्महारथा-
न्समासदत्सिंहशिशुर्यथा गजान् ॥

meaning.en: With his banner raised, bearing a fine karnikara tree, golden-armored, Arjuna's son, better than Arjuna, wishing to fight, met the great chariot-warriors headed by Drona, as a lion cub meets elephants.

verses.text:
ते विंशतिपदे यत्ताः संप्रहारं प्रचक्रिरे ।
आसीद्गाङ्ग इवावर्तो मुहूर्तमुदधेरिव ॥

meaning.en: They fought a close battle, steady, at a distance of twenty paces; for a moment it was like the whirlpool of the Ganga in the ocean.

verses.text:
शूराणां युध्यमानानां निघ्नतामितरेतरम् ।
संग्रामस्तुमुलो राजन्प्रावर्तत सुदारुणः ॥

meaning.en: A tumultuous and very terrible battle began among brave men fighting and killing one another, O king.

verses.text:
प्रवर्तमाने संग्रामे तस्मिन्नतिभयंकरे ।
द्रोणस्य मिषतो व्यूहं भित्त्वा प्राविशदार्जुनिः ॥

meaning.en: As that terrible battle went on, Arjuna's son broke the array and entered it while Drona watched.

verses.text:
तं प्रविष्टं परान्घ्नन्तं शत्रुमध्ये महाबलम् ।
हस्त्यश्वरथपत्त्यौघाः परिवव्रुरुदायुधाः ॥

meaning.en: As that very strong man entered, killing enemies in the midst of his foes, floods of elephants, horses, chariots and foot soldiers with raised weapons surrounded him.

verses.text:
नानावादित्रनिनदैः क्ष्वेडितोत्क्रुष्टगर्जितैः ।
हुंकारैः सिंहनादैश्च तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति निस्वनैः ॥

meaning.en: With the sounds of many instruments, shouts, cries and roars, growls, lion roars and calls of "Stand! Stand!"

verses.text:
घोरैर्हलहलाशब्दैर्मा गास्तिष्ठैहि मामिति ।
असावहममुत्रेति प्रवदन्तो मुहुर्मुहुः ॥

meaning.en: with dreadful hullabaloo, saying "Do not go, stand, come to me," and "I am here, I am there" again and again,

verses.text:
बृंहितैः शिञ्जितैर्हासैः खुरनेमिस्वनैरपि ।
संनादयन्तो वसुधामभिदुद्रुवुरार्जुनिम् ॥

meaning.en: with trumpeting, tinkling, laughter and the sound of hooves and wheel-rims, they rushed at Arjuna's son, making the earth resound.

verses.text:
तेषामापततां वीरः पूर्वं शीघ्रमथो दृढम् ।
क्षिप्रास्त्रो न्यवधीद्व्रातान्मर्मज्ञो मर्मभेदिभिः ॥

meaning.en: As they rushed on, the hero, quick with weapons and knowing the vital places, first quickly and firmly struck down those groups with arrows that pierced vitals.

verses.text:
ते हन्यमानाश्च तथा नानालिङ्गैः शितैः शरैः ।
अभिपेतुस्तमेवाजौ शलभा इव पावकम् ॥

meaning.en: Struck by sharp arrows of many kinds, they fell on him in battle like moths on a fire.

verses.text:
ततस्तेषां शरीरैश्च शरीरावयवैश्च सः ।
संतस्तार क्षितिं क्षिप्रं कुशैर्वेदिमिवाध्वरे ॥

meaning.en: Then with their bodies and limbs he quickly spread the earth, like an altar covered with kusha grass at a sacrifice.

verses.text:
बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणान्सशरावरकार्मुकान् ।
सासिचर्माङ्कुशाभीशून्सतोमरपरश्वधान् ॥

meaning.en: He cut off by thousands the arms of your men, strapped with iguana-skin finger-guards, with shields and bows, with swords, leather shields and goads, with lances and axes,

verses.text:
सगुडायोमुखप्रासान्सर्ष्टितोमरपट्टिशान् ।
सभिण्डिपालपरिघान्सशक्तिवरकम्पनान् ॥

meaning.en: with iron-headed clubs, spears, ox-goads, lances and sabers, with slings and bars, with javelins and fine trembling spears,

verses.text:
सप्रतोदमहाशङ्खान्सकुन्तान्सकचग्रहान् ।
समुद्गरक्षेपणीयान्सपाशपरिघोपलान् ॥

meaning.en: with whips, great conches, pikes, hair-seizing grips, mallets and missiles, with nooses, bars and stones,

verses.text:
सकेयूराङ्गदान्बाहून्हृद्यगन्धानुलेपनान् ।
संचिच्छेदार्जुनिर्वृत्तांस्त्वदीयानां सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: with armlets and bracelets, smeared with pleasant-smelling unguents, round and strong, Arjuna's son cut off thousands of your men's arms.

verses.text:
तैः स्फुरद्भिर्महाराज शुशुभे लोहितोक्षितैः ।
पञ्चास्यैः पन्नगैश्छिन्नैर्गरुडेनेव मारिष ॥

meaning.en: Shining with those quivering, blood-smeared arms, O great king, the earth looked as if covered with five-headed serpents cut apart by Garuda.

verses.text:
सुनासाननकेशान्तैरव्रणैश्चारुकुण्डलैः ।
संदष्टौष्ठपुटैः क्रोधात्क्षरद्भिः शोणितं बहु ॥

meaning.en: With heads with fine noses, faces, hair, unwounded, with lovely earrings, with lips pressed in anger and streaming much blood,

verses.text:
चारुस्रङ्मुकुटोष्णीषैर्मणिरत्नविराजितैः ।
विनालनलिनाकारैर्दिवाकरशशिप्रभैः ॥

meaning.en: with lovely garlands, crowns and turbans, shining with jewels and gems, like stalkless lotuses, with the radiance of sun and moon,

verses.text:
हितप्रियंवदैः काले बहुभिः पुण्यगन्धिभिः ।
द्विषच्छिरोभिः पृथिवीमवतस्तार फाल्गुणिः ॥

meaning.en: with heads of many enemies who had spoken kindly and for his good in time, with a holy fragrance, Phalguna's son covered the earth.

verses.text:
गन्धर्वनगराकारान्विधिवत्कल्पितान्रथान् ।
वीषामुखान्वित्रिवेणून्व्यस्तदण्डकबन्धुरान् ॥

meaning.en: He was seen in all directions breaking with arrows chariots arranged by rule like cities of the Gandharvas, with their poles, platforms and railings,

verses.text:
विजङ्घकूबराक्षांश्च विनेमीननरानपि ।
विचक्रोपस्करोपस्थान्भग्नोपकरणानपि ॥

meaning.en: their broken legs, hubs, axles and wheel-rims, wheelless, with their fittings and gear broken, and thousands of slain warriors,

verses.text:
प्रशातितोपकरणान्हतयोधान्सहस्रशः ।
शरैर्विशकलीकुर्वन्दिक्षु सर्वास्वदृश्यत ॥

meaning.en: his arrows scattering fittings and gear and killing warriors by thousands.

verses.text:
पुनर्द्विपान्द्विपारोहान्वैजयन्त्यङ्कुशध्वजान् ।
तूणान्वर्माण्यथो कक्ष्या ग्रैवेयानथ कम्बलान् ॥

meaning.en: Again with arrows with edges sharp as razors he shattered the enemies' elephants and elephant-riders, their banners and goads, quivers, armor, girths, necklaces and blankets,

verses.text:
घण्टाः शुण्डान्विषाणाग्रान्क्षुरपालान्पदानुगान् ।
शरैर्निशितधाराग्रैः शात्रवाणामशातयत् ॥

meaning.en: their bells, trunks, tusk-tips, foot-guards and attendants on foot,

verses.text:
वनायुजान्पार्वतीयान्काम्बोजारट्टबाह्लिकान् ।
स्थिरवालधिकर्णाक्षाञ्जवनान्साधुवाहिनः ॥

meaning.en: and horses bred in Vanayu, mountains, Kamboja, Aratta and Bahlika, with steady tails, ears and eyes, swift and good bearers,

verses.text:
स्वारूढाञ्शिक्षितैर्योधैः शक्त्यृष्टिप्रासयोधिभिः ।
विध्वस्तचामरकुथान्विप्रकीर्णप्रकीर्णकान् ॥

meaning.en: ridden by trained warriors who fought with spears, swords and lances, their yak-tail whisks and blankets ruined and cloth scattered,

verses.text:
निरस्तजिह्वानयनान्निष्कीर्णान्त्रयकृद्घनान् ।
हतारोहान्भिन्नभाण्डान्क्रव्यादगणमोदनान् ॥

meaning.en: their tongues and eyes thrown out, entrails and livers spilled, riders dead and gear broken, a joy to flocks of flesh-eaters,

verses.text:
निकृत्तवर्मकवचाञ्शकृन्मूत्रासृगाप्लुतान् ।
निपातयन्नश्ववरांस्तावकान्सोऽभ्यरोचत ॥

meaning.en: with armor and coats cut off, drenched in dung, urine and blood; felling your best horses he shone.

verses.text:
एको विष्णुरिवाचिन्त्यः कृत्वा प्राक्कर्म दुष्करम् ।
तथा विमथितं तेन त्र्यङ्गं तव बलं महत् ।
व्यहनत्स पदात्योघांस्त्वदीयानेव भारत ॥

meaning.en: Alone, like unthinkable Vishnu, having done his hard deed before, he so churned your great three-limbed force that he struck down your troops of foot soldiers, O Bharata.

verses.text:
एवमेकेन तां सेनां सौभद्रेण शितैः शरैः ।
भृशं विप्रहतां दृष्ट्वा स्कन्देनेवासुरीं चमूम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that army so heavily struck by Subhadra's son alone with sharp arrows, like the Asura host by Skanda,

verses.text:
त्वदीयास्तव पुत्राश्च वीक्षमाणा दिशो दश ।
संशुष्कास्याश्चलन्नेत्राः प्रस्विन्ना लोमहर्षणाः ॥

meaning.en: your men and your sons, looking in all ten directions, their mouths dry, their eyes rolling, sweating, their hair standing on end,

verses.text:
पलायनकृतोत्साहा निरुत्साहा द्विषज्जये ।
गोत्रनामभिरन्योन्यं क्रन्दन्तो जीवितैषिणः ॥

meaning.en: set on flight and without spirit to conquer the enemy, called out to each other by clan and name, wishing to live.

verses.text:
हतान्पुत्रांस्तथा पितॄन्सुहृत्संबन्धिबान्धवान् ।
प्रातिष्ठन्त समुत्सृज्य त्वरयन्तो हयद्विपान् ॥

meaning.en: They left behind their slain sons, fathers, friends, relatives and kin, and set off, urging on their horses and elephants.
